projectContext: Enhance caption-first mode with parallel processing, better resilience, and advanced features. Sprint 4 built the foundation (CaptionFetcher, CaptionStage, cache, retry logic, normalization, CLI, metrics). Sprint 5 focuses on performance (parallel fetch), reliability (live stream detection, corrupted caption handling), flexibility (language fallback chains, format preferences), and advanced workflows (batch operations, coverage metrics, playlist support).

userStories.title: Implement parallel caption fetching with ThreadPoolExecutor
userStories.description: The CaptionStage currently fetches captions sequentially, which is slow for projects with 50+ videos. Implement parallel fetching using ThreadPoolExecutor to fetch 3-5 videos concurrently, following the pattern in src/transcription/parallel_processor.py.
acceptanceCriteria: Add fetch_captions_batch() method to CaptionFetcher using ThreadPoolExecutor
Default max_workers=4 with config option caption_first.max_parallel_fetches
Thread-safe metrics tracking using Lock for CaptionMetrics
CaptionStage uses batch fetch instead of sequential loop
Progress callback support for real-time updates during batch fetch
Tests verify parallel execution completes faster than sequential for 10+ videos
userStories.notes: Already implemented in commit 04b862b. All 6 acceptance criteria verified: fetch_captions_batch() uses ThreadPoolExecutor, max_parallel_fetches=4 config option, CaptionMetrics uses Lock for thread-safety, CaptionStage calls batch fetch, progress_callback parameter supported, tests verify parallel faster than sequential.

userStories.title: Add live stream detection to skip caption fetch
userStories.description: Caption fetching can hang indefinitely on live streams. Add detection to identify live/premiering videos and skip caption fetch with a warning, preventing 30-second timeouts.
acceptanceCriteria: New is_live_stream(video_id) method using yt-dlp --dump-json metadata
Check 'is_live' and 'was_live' fields from video metadata
CaptionStage skips live streams with logged warning
Metrics track skipped live streams separately from unavailable captions
Config option caption_first.skip_live_streams (default: true)
Tests verify live stream detection with mocked yt-dlp output
userStories.notes: Already implemented in commit c0bbb26. All 6 acceptance criteria verified: is_live_stream() uses yt-dlp --dump-json (lines 1490-1576 in caption_fetcher.py), checks is_live/was_live fields (lines 1555-1564), CaptionStage skips with warning (lines 139-161 in caption_stage.py), CaptionMetrics.record_skipped_live_stream() tracks separately, config.download.caption_first.skip_live_streams=true (line 199 in download.py), 15 tests pass including 8 detection tests and 7 metrics tests.

userStories.title: Implement configurable language fallback chain
userStories.description: Currently falls back to English, then any available language. Add support for user-defined fallback chains for multilingual projects (e.g., es -> en -> pt).
acceptanceCriteria: New config option caption_first.fallback_languages: list of ISO 639-1 codes
select_best_language() uses fallback_languages before falling back to 'any'
Fallback chain stops at first available language
Log which language was selected from which position in chain
Empty or missing fallback_languages preserves current behavior (en -> any)
Tests verify fallback chain selection with various language availability
userStories.notes: Implemented in commit 29d9519. All 6 acceptance criteria verified: fallback_languages config option added (List[str], default=[]), select_best_language() checks fallback chain before English fallback, chain stops at first available, logging shows position (e.g., 'from fallback chain position 1'), empty list preserves original behavior, 17 new tests covering all scenarios.

userStories.title: Add caption coverage percentage metrics
userStories.description: Track and report what percentage of video duration is covered by captions. Flag videos with low coverage (<50%) for potential transcription fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: New calculate_coverage() method returns coverage ratio (0.0-1.0) from segments
CaptionResult gains coverage_ratio field calculated from segments
Config option caption_first.min_coverage_threshold (default: 0.5)
Warnings logged for videos below coverage threshold
CaptionMetrics tracks coverage distribution (high >80%, medium 50-80%, low <50%)
Tests verify coverage calculation with various segment patterns
userStories.notes: Implemented in commit 19f3731. All 6 acceptance criteria verified: calculate_coverage() method added to CaptionResult (sums segment durations / video_duration), video_duration and coverage_ratio fields added, min_coverage_threshold=0.5 in CaptionFirstConfig and config.yaml, warnings logged for videos below threshold, CaptionMetrics tracks coverage_distribution and low_coverage_videos, 36 new tests added for coverage calculation and metrics.

userStories.title: Handle corrupted captions with partial recovery
userStories.description: A single malformed caption segment can break parsing. Implement graceful degradation that skips bad segments and uses partial results, logging which segments were skipped.
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionNormalizer.normalize() catches per-segment parsing errors
Malformed segments are logged and skipped, not fatal
CaptionResult gains skipped_segments_count field
Partial results accepted if >50% of segments parse successfully
New CaptionParseWarning for non-fatal parsing issues
Tests verify partial recovery with intentionally malformed input
userStories.notes: Implemented. All 6 acceptance criteria verified: (1) normalize() now wraps per-segment validation in try/except (lines 2196-2218), (2) Malformed segments logged with warning and skipped, (3) CaptionResult.skipped_segments_count field added (line 212), (4) 50% threshold via min_success_ratio param - only counts actual parse errors, not intentional filters (lines 2223-2236), (5) CaptionParseWarning exception class added (lines 149-167), (6) 15 new tests added in TestPartialRecovery, TestCaptionParseWarning, TestCaptionResultSkippedCount classes. normalize() now returns tuple (segments, skipped_count). Tests updated to use tuple unpacking.

userStories.title: Add caption format preference configuration
userStories.description: Let users specify preferred caption formats (VTT, SRT, JSON3) to work around format-specific parsing issues or optimize for speed (JSON3 is pre-structured).
acceptanceCriteria: New config option caption_first.preferred_formats: list (default: ['json3', 'vtt', 'srt'])
CaptionFetcher tries formats in preference order
JSON3 preferred by default since it's already structured
Fallback to next format on parse error (not just unavailable)
Log which format was ultimately used
Tests verify format selection and fallback behavior
userStories.notes: Implemented. All 6 acceptance criteria verified: (1) preferred_formats config option added to CaptionFirstConfig (default: ['json3', 'vtt', 'srt']), (2) CaptionFetcher._fetch_subtitle() now iterates through _preferred_formats, calling _fetch_subtitle_with_format() for each, (3) json3 is first in default list since it's pre-structured, (4) CaptionFetchError caught in format loop triggers fallback to next format (not just CaptionUnavailableError), (5) logger.info() logs 'Using {fmt} format ({N} segments)' when format succeeds, (6) 11 new tests in TestCaptionFormatPreference class covering: default formats, config formats, format order, parse error fallback, first success, logging, exhausted formats, custom order, single format, unavailable error fallback.

userStories.title: Validate caption timestamps against video duration
userStories.description: Captions can be out of sync if timestamps exceed video duration. Add validation that compares caption duration to video duration and flags mismatches.
acceptanceCriteria: New validate_timing(video_duration) method on CaptionResult
Compare last segment end_time to video duration
Flag if caption duration > video_duration * 1.1 (10% tolerance)
Flag if caption duration < video_duration * 0.5 (coverage too low)
Validation result stored in CaptionResult.timing_validated field
Tests verify timing validation with edge cases

userStories.title: Implement caption availability pre-check
userStories.description: Before fetching full captions, quickly check if captions are available at all using yt-dlp --list-subs. This avoids wasted network calls for videos without captions.
acceptanceCriteria: New has_captions(video_id) method using list_available_languages()
Returns boolean without downloading actual caption content
CaptionStage can pre-filter candidates to those with captions
Config option caption_first.pre_check_availability (default: true)
Metrics track pre-check results (available/unavailable counts)
Tests verify pre-check correctly identifies caption availability

userStories.title: Add streaming progress output for caption fetch
userStories.description: Currently only shows summary after all fetches complete. Add real-time streaming output showing progress per video: language, quality, segment count.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress callback parameter for fetch_captions_batch()
Callback receives: video_id, status ('fetching'/'success'/'failed'), details dict
CaptionStage uses callback to print real-time progress
Format: [32/100] abc123XYZ: en (auto, 45 segments, quality=medium)
Support both TTY (overwrite line) and non-TTY (newline per video) output
Tests verify callback is invoked with correct parameters

userStories.title: Create caption health check script for test fixtures
userStories.description: Integration tests depend on specific YouTube videos having captions. Create a health check script that validates fixture video IDs still have expected caption states.
acceptanceCriteria: New scripts/check_caption_fixtures.py script
Reads VIDEO_FIXTURES from tests/test_caption_integration.py
Checks each fixture video: exists, has captions, matches expected state
Reports mismatches with suggested updates
Exit code 0 if all fixtures valid, 1 if any need attention
Can be run manually or in CI (optional GitHub Action workflow)
